centre.name: Kelburn Recovery Centre

about_blocks.text: Kelburn Recovery Centre is a leading addiction treatment center with a private country setting that ensures complete confidentiality. The facility specializes in treating addiction and co-occurring mental health conditions. Kelburn Recovery Center provides flexible treatment designed to cater to the specific needs of its clients. The center offers non-medical detox, interventions services, residential care, and outpatient services. At Kelburn Recovery, clients benefit from personalized treatment plans and individualized, holistic approaches.

about_blocks.text: At Kelburn Recovery Centre, clients are provided with an individualized and holistic approach to addiction treatment. The center offers daily one-on-one counseling, small intimate group therapy, daily symptom management therapy, weekly post traumatic stress (PTSD) therapy, and daily physical exercise and swimming, among other activities. Kelburn Recovery Centre’s personalized, holistic approach ensures that each client receives the support and care that they need to achieve long-term recovery.

about_blocks.text: Kelburn Recovery Centre is located 7 kilometers south of Winnipeg on 45 beautiful acres along the Red River. The center offers a 10,000 square-foot residential home with 10 bedrooms, allowing clients to share a bedroom with one other roommate. The property provides numerous activities like the 9-hole PGA standard golf course, indoor swimming pool, sauna, and recreation room. The outdoor property comprises beautiful lakes and seasoned walking paths used for cross-country skiing in the winter and peaceful strolls in the summer.

about_blocks.text: Kelburn Recovery Centre offers a range of support services to ensure that clients receive the best possible care. The center provides non-medical detox services, interventions services, residential care, and outpatient services. Clients also benefit from a team of experienced healthcare professionals, including certified addiction counselors, licensed psychologists, psychiatrists, and medical doctors. Additionally, Kelburn Recovery Centre offers comprehensive aftercare services designed to help clients achieve long-term recovery.

about_blocks.text: The New Kelburn Recovery Centre is a premier rehabilitation facility located in Southern Manitoba, Canada. Under new ownership since January of 2023, the center offers inpatient treatment programs that start at 42 days and include a range of comprehensive services aimed at achieving successful levels of personal, social, and occupational functioning. With a certified team of professionals, including doctors, nurses, psychotherapists, clinical counselors, a registered massage therapist, a knowledge keeper, a master fitness trainer, and a red seal chef, clients can rest assured they are receiving the highest level of care.

about_blocks.text: The New Kelburn Recovery Centre is committed to providing responsible and evidence-based treatment practices in a professional and affordable manner. Their multidisciplinary approach to recovery focuses on teaching constructive life skills as a means of discontinuing harmful or self-limiting behavior. With medically assisted detox, psychiatric assessments, customized therapy, and after-care support, their programs are tailored to meet the individual needs of clients. Overall, the center’s ultimate goal is to help clients achieve lasting recovery and improve their overall quality of life.
